## Goal of ML

The goal of machine learning is to develop and implement a machine which can predict an outcome $\mathcal{Y}$ of some inputs $\mathcal{X}$ given some kind of knowledge $\theta$. The way this knowledge $\theta$ is defined depends on different types of machine learning algorithms. The knowledge $\theta$ is derived by a "learning" process in which the goal is to "learn" what knowledge $\theta$ leads to the expected outcome $\mathcal{Y}$. How this learning process exactly looks, depends on the type of learning: [[Supervised Learning]], [[Unsupervised Learning]], [[Reinforcement Learning]]. The type of the learning depends on the problem one tries to solve.
